source: Explicit user request in Codex chat 01a159d1-5e22-7e13-9fe0-99f4c15c6000
scope: Implement bounded consolidation of one task across episodes and sessions, and measure its effect with live models.
product_requirements: Merge only with supported task identity. Shared chat, topic, or words alone are insufficient.
Retain goals, active constraints, decision reasons, confirmed results, and unfinished work. Apply late corrections while retaining provenance.
An assistant report is not independent evidence of completion. Keep local validation, deployment, and production distinct.
Keep ambiguous links and contradictions visible. Do not close obligations to simplify a summary.
Keep exact evidence for each material field and links from derived records to original events.
Make jobs repeatable, restart safe, and safe against concurrent writes or source deletion. Old jobs must not restore forgotten content.
Bound input, source disclosure, attempts, and time. Account for every attempt. Reads must not invoke a model.
Keep observation coverage gaps visible. Captured events are not a complete transcript.

test_contract.observation: Read results through ProjectMemory on a real temporary Store.
required_scenarios: Existing database migration if schema changes

experiment_requirements.target: 20 new fictional histories with six questions each, split into development and held-out sets.
experiment_requirements.freeze: Freeze code and criteria before revealing held-out histories to the implementer.
experiment_requirements.reader: A fresh model receives memory and questions only.
experiment_requirements.judge: A separate model receives source history, expected facts, forbidden conclusions, evidence, and the answer without the variant label.
metrics: Correct current state and useful continuation
Retention of constraints, obligations, and decision reasons
False merges, closures, project mixing, and deleted-content resurrection
Latency, context size, and full attempt usage/cost
experiment_requirements.repetition: Repeat a subset to assess instability, including generation.
experiment_requirements.empty_answers: Cautious but empty answers are not improvements.

completion_requirements: Required test suite, acceptance, and package build
Architecture source review, candidate update, snapshot, full finalize, seal, and check
Independent standards and requirements code reviews
Reproducible experiment with per-question results and error analysis
Separate pilot readiness from installed service state
not_authorized_or_requested: Install or restart the production service
Publish a release or push a commit
